title: Promo: product or service ad
description: Ad built from scene types (hook, statement, features, media, product, stat, cta) placed on the beat. Short (~15 s) and full (~27 s) cuts in 16:9 and 9:16.
next: cd into the project folder, run npm ci once, edit content.json (put images and videos in public/media), then: npm run studio, or: python scripts/studio.py render --project {name} --comp Promo-Short-9x16
